name: pathseek
title: PathSeek – File Navigator
description: Search a manually maintained file index and navigate to files quickly on macOS.
author: juezhong

preferences.name: searchRoots
preferences.title: Search Roots
preferences.description: Directories to index, separated by semicolons. ~ expands to your home directory.

preferences.name: includeHidden
preferences.title: Include Hidden Files
preferences.description: Include hidden files and directories when rebuilding the index.
preferences.label: Include hidden paths

preferences.name: followSymlinks
preferences.title: Follow Symbolic Links
preferences.description: Follow symlinked directories (can cause extensive traversal).
preferences.label: Follow symlinked directories

preferences.name: excludePatterns
preferences.title: Exclude Patterns
preferences.description: Optional fd glob patterns to exclude, separated by commas.

preferences.name: fdBinary
preferences.title: fd Executable
preferences.description: Optional absolute path. Default: find fd in Homebrew, Cargo or PATH.

preferences.name: fzfBinary
preferences.title: fzf Executable
preferences.description: Optional absolute path. Default: find fzf in Homebrew or PATH.

commands.name: search-files
commands.title: Search Files
commands.description: Search files and folders using the saved index.

commands.name: rebuild-index
commands.title: Rebuild Index
commands.description: Manually regenerate the persistent file index with fd.

commands.name: index-status
commands.title: Index Status
commands.description: Inspect the persistent index and open its storage directory.

commands.name: debug-info
commands.title: Debug Info
commands.description: Copy sanitized system, Raycast, Node.js and index diagnostics.
